Kit summary

Graceful Umbrella DanceBasic
Deals 260% ATK [Bleed] DMG to a single enemy, with a 80% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns.
Art of ExplosionActiveExclusive Lv.1
There is a 100% chance to inflict [SPD Down Ⅱ] for 2 turns and [Hypnotize] for 1 turn on all enemies. Afterward, deals 140% ATK [Bleed] DMG to all enemies.
Ornate Umbrella Lv.1Removes all buffs from enemies first when casting Art of Explosion. Only takes effect once each wave: when any enemy is immune to the control effect inflicted by Elise, Elise grants all allies [DMG Immunity] for 1 turn.
Exquisite ElegancePassiveExclusive Lv.3
Increases Elise's Shield Effect by 13% of her initial Effect Hit (up to 240% Effect Hit can be calculated). Max limit of Resonance Points: 10. When allies try inflicting control effects on enemies during their turns, grants Elise 1 Resonance Point; each ally can only grant Elise 1 Resonance Point each turn. For every 1 Resonance Point gained by Elise, grants all allies 1 layer of [Gorgeous Shield] by 18% of Elise's Max HP for 2 turns, up to 4 layers can be owned.
Ornate Umbrella Lv.3At the beginning of each wave, Elise gains Resonance Points equal to the number of allies with the [Control] tag. For every 1 Resonance Point gained by Elise, increases her Turn Meter by 5%. If she has 200% or more Effect Hit initially, when any ally with [Shield] takes DMG from enemies (excluding Boss), each stage of DMG will be no more than their total Shield value.
Phantom DancerActiveExclusive Lv.2
Deals 100% ATK [Bleed] DMG to all enemies and reduces targets' Turn Meters by 12%, with a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns. When Resonance Points reach the max limit, replaces it with Phantom Dancer · Resonance and resets its CD.
Ornate Umbrella Lv.2At the beginning of each wave and each time after Phantom Dancer or Phantom Dancer · Resonance is cast, Elise grants all allies [Indomitable II] (reduces DoT taken by 40%) for 2 turns; if the ally has the [Control] tag, upgrades the buff to [Resilient Spirit] (reduces DoT taken by 60%).
Phantom Dancer · ResonanceActiveExclusive Lv.2
Deals 1 stage of 100% ATK [Bleed] DMG to all enemies. Afterward, deals 5 stages of DMG, each deals 100% ATK [Bleed] DMG to 1 random enemy. All DMG dealt by this skill is considered as Resonance DMG. Besides, each stage reduces the target's Turn Meter by 12% and has a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns.
Ornate Umbrella Lv.2At the beginning of each wave and each time after Phantom Dancer or Phantom Dancer · Resonance is cast, Elise grants all allies [Indomitable II] (reduces DoT taken by 40%) for 2 turns; if the ally has the [Control] tag, upgrades the buff to [Resilient Spirit] (reduces DoT taken by 60%).
